what: A large illustration behind the section (like a brush heart) is tied to section scroll and swells 1 → 1.5x (scrub 1, GSAP default power1.out) — the range runs from when the section center touches the screen bottom to when the section’s bottom edge passes the screen top. At widths 767 and below it grows up to 2x. If opacity moves along with it, it fades as it grows (careers heart 1 → 1.8x · 1 → .5)

options.[data-fx-part=art]: Growing image (child) — absolutely positioned image slot covering the section
options.from-narrow · to-narrow: Start and end scale for narrow screens (narrow and below) — if absent, use from and to (original slogan section to-narrow 2, hiring section .8 · 1.4)
options.opacity: End opacity — if given, opacity moves too (recruit heart .5)
options.start · end: ScrollTrigger range, default center bottom · bottom top
options.ease: Curve, default power1.out — because the original put ease: none in the scrollTrigger slot and it was ignored

from.where: index.html .om-statement — two red and teal brush hearts (behind the slogan section, 1 → 1.5 · phone 2, center bottom → bottom top)
recruit.html .om-career — white line heart (1 → 1.8 · phone .8 → 1.4, opacity 1 → .5, top center → bottom center)
from.options: from-narrow: .8; to: 1.8; to-narrow: 1.4; opacity: .5; start: top center; end: bottom center
